description: A relational sorted theory is satisfiable if and only if its erased first-order theory, including every sort-existence axiom, is satisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.satisfiable_iff.{u, v}
  (L : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Signature)
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Theory L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.IsSatisfiable L T ↔
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.eraseTheory L T).IsSatisfiable
